description: Search TakeMeUp.cv's CV, resume and job-search guides by topic and return the best matches with a summary and link. Use to answer a CV, resume, cover-letter, interview or job-application question with a guide the user can read, e.g. "photo on a German CV" or "how long should a CV be".

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

query.description: The question or topic, e.g. "photo on a German CV" or "does a cover letter matter in the Netherlands".

name: search_takemeup_guides
title: Search TakeMeUp CV guides
